text:
BENGALURU ROBOTICS AND AI
INNOVATION ZONE

India's premier 9-acre deep-tech campus purpose-built for rapid discovery, organic collaboration, and faster market impact.

Leading AI and Robotics in India

BRAINz is dedicated to accelerating innovations in AI, robotics, and enabling technologies for critical domains including Space Tech, Aerospace & Defence, Advanced Manufacturing, and MedTech.

Based on economic models proven to drive growth and IP generation, our vision is to build futuristic collaboration spaces built to encourage cooperation, drive ideations and overall improve the odds to innovation success.

Backed By
Technology Areas
Advanced Manufacturing

Robotics, automation, and AI-driven production systems for India's industrial base.

HealthTech

Diagnostics AI, surgical robotics, and clinical decision infrastructure for population-scale healthcare.

Aerospace & Defence

Autonomous systems, surveillance robotics, and next-generation propulsion technologies.

SpaceTech

Satellite systems, earth observation, and in-space propulsion for India's commercial space economy.

Five Purpose-Built Spaces
01
Prototyping and Experimentation Labs

Advanced fabrication, electronics assembly, and testing infrastructure — allowing teams to move from simulation to physical prototype rapidly and iteratively.

02
Global Innovation Centers

Dedicated spaces for international corporations, research institutions, and government bodies to co-innovate with India's deep-tech ecosystem.

03
Innovation Spaces and Pods

Flexible, modular work environments for startups, research groups, and corporate R&D teams.

04
Open Innovation Zones for Collaboration

Public-facing innovation spaces where industry, academia, government, and civil society can engage.

05
Academic Research and Skilling

Dedicated zones for faculty research, postdoctoral work, and skilling and fellowship programmes.

Partner To build BRAINz
The Vision Partner

Naming rights for the entire campus

A permanent seat on the governing board, providing a strategic role in shaping a national asset.

The Pillar Partner

Naming rights for a key campus facility

Prominent branding at the entrance of the named centre or facility of National Importance.

The Support Partner

"Founding Partners" of a prestigious institution

Permanent installation at the entrance of the campus, acknowledging the critical role, and inclusion in all associated branding and press releases.

Whether you are a potential partner, a researcher, or an institution interested in being part of BRAINz, we want to hear from you.
